<thought>The HSQC shows a signal at 2.22 ppm (6 H) correlated to a carbon at 19.4 ppm. Six protons attached to that carbon correspond to two CH₃ groups (each contributes 3 H). No other methyl‑type signals are present. Therefore the molecule contains two methyl groups.</thought>
